digest.component_or_area: store healing: sync and S3 doctor
propositions: A behaviour-preserving shared reconcile_one function cannot be extracted because sync and the S3 doctor hold contradictory policies on unrelated histories: sync refuses to merge on a non-empty local store to prevent grafting, while the doctor unions unconditionally.

Sync cannot adopt the doctor's merge-tree/commit-tree ref-only merge strategy because sync consumers read ticket events from worktree files, and a ref-only merge would leave readers on pre-merge state.
The two healers hold opposite failure policies: sync must never raise and swallows all exceptions in its read path, while the doctor must raise S3DoctorConflict to signal the push path to abandon.

The duplication this ticket targeted was removed by Gerrit 1665, which replaced the doctor's worktree-based git merge with a worktree-free merge-tree/commit-tree approach into the published ref, making the targeted duplication obsolete.
